paragraphs: Rabbi Chanina bar Avdimi — Nedarim 60b as cited by Hyman, compare [Nedarim 61b:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.61b.4)[^3]; Rav Chisda bar Avdimi — [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.8); Rav Yosef bar Avdimi — [Eruvin 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.8a.12); Rabbi Yitzchak bar Avdima (a Tanna) — [Berakhot 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.33b.10); Rabbi Yitzchak bar Avdima (an Amora) — [Shabbat 77b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.77b.2); Rabbi Shmuel bar Avdimi — Terumot, beginning of chapter 9; Rabbi Tachlifa bar Avdimi — [Pesachim 100a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.100a.10).[^2]

notes.text: The notice separately labels one Yitzchak bar Avdima a Tanna and another an Amora.

The two linked notices for Yitzchak give a tradition from his teacher and a separate statement about wording in Ezekiel. Hyman places them under distinct labels. Pesachim calls Tachlifa Rav and has him transmit in Shmuel’s name.
In the linked passage Rabbi Chanina bar Avdimi says in Rav’s name that the attributions of the opinions are reversed.
